mode_note: Mode `default` is pre-registration section 6's mode B (machine-default threads, sequential). Mode A has not been run. The two modes are NEVER pooled into a single +/-.
aggregation_rule: mean +/- sample std (ddof=1) over the 5 seeds, within one execution mode. A seed varies parameter initialisation and minibatch order only, on a fixed sample, so every +/- is initialisation-and-batch-order variance.
table4_elsewhere: L24 is measured by results/lanl_v2/h1_auth_presence.json, h1_occupancy_decomposition.json and h1_conditional_rates.json. It does not depend on the sweep and is not recomputed here.

table1_roc_auc_per_cell.what: ROC AUC and companions, mean +/- sample std (ddof=1) over the 5 seeds, per arm x system. Mode `default` (B) only.
table1_roc_auc_per_cell.secondary_note: balanced_accuracy and attack_recall are SECONDARY (Amendment 1, section 10.1). No hypothesis is decided on a threshold metric.

table3_leave_host_out.what: L27 leave-host-out test ROC AUC delta, 8 arm x system rows x 5 hosts. Re-scored from the committed per-row arrays; no model is rebuilt.
table3_leave_host_out.interval: NONE. One host is not a resample, so no interval is attached and the result is descriptive. Part 30 records the same.
table3_leave_host_out.pre_registration_status: Only the C17693 column carries H2's bar. The other hosts are NOT pre-registered for Part 38 and are a descriptive mirror of Part 30's committed 40-cell table; they cannot confirm or disconfirm H2 and must not be aggregated with the C17693 column.

hosts.host_rule: The 5 computers with the most TEST rows of label attack, ranked by that count, ties broken by computer name ascending.
hosts.re_derived_on: Part 38's own test block, not copied from Part 30

h2_verdict.rule: H2 is disconfirmed if ANY of the eight arm-and-system cells moves by 0.036 or more in absolute value.
h2_verdict.sharpness_warning: Part 30's own committed C17693 band is 0.035963 to 0.051875 over the same eight cells, and its smallest cell (without_dns/naive, -0.035963) is BELOW this 0.036 bar. A Part 38 cell reproducing Part 30's weakest cell would be scored as passing, so a CONFIRMED verdict does not by itself mean the sensitivity shrank. Read the per-cell vs_part30 column.
h2_verdict.realised_share_caveat: The k=2 size fallback fired, so the realised attack-host benign share is 1/4, not 1/1. A disconfirmation shows that restoring a QUARTER of the benign contrast did not help, which is narrower than H2's mechanism.

table6_operational.what: Operational record and the Amendment 10.2 threshold-degeneracy diagnostic. No hypothesis is attached to any of it.
table6_operational.peak_rss_mb_semantic: peak_rss_mb is a RUNNING MAXIMUM over the life of the process that wrote the unit, not a per-unit measurement. Within one launch it is non-decreasing, so a unit's figure includes memory peaks caused by EARLIER units in the same process: measured 499.5 then 528.8 for with_auth naive_seed4 then prismflow_seed2 in one process on 2026-11-22. Reported per seed and never averaged -- units written by one long-lived process can all carry that process's plateau, so a mean over them counts one observation n times and its std is 0.0 by construction rather than by reproducibility. n_distinct counts the distinct values in this cell, which is a lower bound on the launches that wrote it and not a fixed number of regimes.
table6_operational.peak_rss_mb_launch_identity: not measured: the unit JSON records no process_id and no launch_time, so which launch produced a given peak_rss_mb is not derivable from committed data. File mtime is not a substitute -- a git checkout rewrites it. Identical values across seeds are the only evidence that two units shared a process.
table6_operational.unit_seconds_semantic: unit_seconds is aggregated, but the seeds of a cell may span launches with different machine states: with_auth/naive seeds 0,1 measured 653.8s and 705.4s while seeds 2,3 measured 1359.8s and 1370.8s, a 2.0x difference in the same field of the same cell. Each value is a genuine per-unit measurement, so the mean is a legitimate operational summary; it is not a reproducibility figure.
table6_operational.degeneracy_definition: A unit whose max prob_attack is below 0.5 is degenerate at the default threshold, which pins balanced accuracy at exactly 0.5 whatever the ranking underneath it.
